docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Set in the Bengal famine of 1770 and the sannyāsī rebellion that followed, Ānandamaṭh tells of an order of ascetic warriors, the santāns, who fight for the motherland. The song “Vande Mātaram”, sung in the novel by the monk Bhavānanda, became the anthem of the freedom movement. Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay (1838–1894) first serialised the novel in his journal Baṅgadarśan and published it as a book in 1882; this is the text of the edition of 1883, as proofread on Bengali Wikisource.
